title: Transformation of Heterologous DNA in Bacillus subtilis
author: Kristoffer Bach Falkenberg
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdmti46n

steps.title: Prepare 10x SM1 Stock
steps.instruction: Prepare 10x SM1 stock in a 100mL blue cap bottle.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 2 g ammonium sulphate, 14 g dipotassium hydrogen phosphate, 6 g potassium dihydrogen phosphate, 0.7 g sodium citrate, 0.2 g magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, 2 g yeast extract, and 0.25 g casamino acids.
Add MQ water to 100 mL and mix to dissolve ingredients.

steps.title: Prepare 1x SM2 Stock
steps.instruction: Prepare 1x SM2 stock in a 1L blue cap bottle.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 2 g ammonium sulfate, 14 g dipotassium hydrogen phosphate, 6 g potassium dihydrogen phosphate, 0.7 g sodium citrate, 0.8 g magnesium sulfate heptahydrate, 1 g yeast extract, and 0.1 g casamino acids.
Add MQ water to 1 L and mix to dissolve ingredients.

steps.title: Sterilize and Store Stocks
steps.instruction: Autoclave the stocks and store at Room temperature or 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Auxiliary Stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare 200g/L glucose and 1M CaCl2 stocks separately.

steps.title: Prepare Fresh SM1 Media
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh SM1 media from the stock.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1 part 10x SM1 media stock with 9 parts sterile MQ water.
Add 25uL of 200g/L glucose stock per mL of media (final concentration of 5g/L).

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Overnight Culture
steps.instruction: Prepare an overnight culture of B. subtilis.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 10mL SM1 media in a 50mL falcon tube with a single colony from a freshly streaked plate.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C with 250RPM shaking.
Ensure incubation does not exceed 16:00:00 to maintain transformation efficiency.

steps.title: Expand Culture to Target OD
steps.instruction: Dilute and grow the culture to a specific density.

substeps.instruction: Measure OD 600 of the overnight culture.
Dilute the overnight culture in 10 mL SM1 media to a final OD 600 of 0.5 in a 250 mL Erlenmeyer flask.
Grow culture at 37 °C at 250 RPM shaking for 03:00:00.

steps.title: Induce Competence
steps.instruction: Treat the culture to make cells competent.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL SM2 medium to the culture.
Add 250 µL 200g/L glucose stock to the culture.
Swirl the culture and add 45 µL 1M CaCl2 stock while the media is still in motion to prevent precipitation.
Grow culture at 37 °C at 250 RPM shaking for 02:00:00.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Distribute cells into aliquots for transformation or storage.

substeps.instruction: Distribute cells in 500 µL aliquots in 2 mL eppendorf tubes.
Optional: To freeze, add 250 µL 50% volume glycerol to aliquots and store at -80 °C. Thaw on ice to restart.

steps.title: Transform DNA
steps.instruction: Introduce plasmid DNA into the competent cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 250ng - 1pg of plasmid DNA (circular, linearized, or PCR products) to the aliquots.
Incubate aliquots in a thermoblock for 00:30:00 at 37 °C with 800 RPM shaking.

steps.title: Recover Cells
steps.instruction: Allow cells to recover before plating.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL LB media.
Recover cells for at least 02:00:00 at 37 °C with 800 RPM shaking.

steps.title: Plate and Incubate
steps.instruction: Select for transformed colonies on agar plates.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Centrifuge aliquots at 6000 x g for 2 minutes and reinoculate in a smaller volume to increase colony count.
Plate up to 200 µL of each aliquot on LB agar plates with appropriate antibiotics.
Incubate plates overnight at 37 °C.
